about_short_description.short_description: Vizcom is an AI-powered creative tool designed for industrial designers and artists.

product.name: Sketch to 3D Model Conversion
product.description: Transforms sketches into photorealistic renders and 3D models quickly, enabling visualization from multiple angles and export for AR or 3D printing.

product.name: Palettes
product.description: A feature that creates personalized AI models trained on user-provided images to generate renderings consistent with a specific aesthetic style.

product.name: Workbench
product.description: An infinite canvas environment for collaborative exploration and organization of design ideas with responsive layout features.

product.name: Visual Communication with Reference Imagery
product.description: Integrates reference images into the design process to guide and refine the visual language of sketches and renderings.

product.name: Custom AI Model Training
product.description: Develops tailored AI models trained on an organization's proprietary design data to generate renderings aligned with their unique brand style.
